title: Everything is OK · Tonight
description: How lively the world is and what people do there, counts only. Right now tiles show the present; the rest follow the selected range (several weeks can overcount where the usage counters restarted). Ops stay on the Everything is OK dashboard.

panels.title: The vibe
panels.description: People in the production world right now (polled every minute): 0 quiet, 1–3 cozy, 4 or more lively.

panels.title: People here
panels.description: People in the production world right now, in public and private instances (polled every minute).

panels.title: Rooms
panels.description: Public instances of the production world right now (VRChat lists only those), and the tablets (rooms) that made any request in the selected range. Includes the owner's testing in the TEST world, which these counts can't tell apart.

panels.title: Warmth, this range
panels.description: New visits and favorites of the production world over the selected range (unfavorites net out).

panels.title: Heat
panels.description: VRChat's heat for the production world right now (the flames on its world page, polled every 15 min): one lit flame per point up to 7, and the number beside them above that.

panels.title: Plays by length
panels.description: Videos played over the selected range, once per room, by length. Includes the owner's testing in the TEST world, which these counts can't tell apart.

panels.title: Channels and searches
panels.description: Over the selected range: Channels slots opened, searches with a query, and videos played (once per room). Includes the owner's testing in the TEST world, which these counts can't tell apart.

panels.title: Captions and quality
panels.description: Over the selected range: captions turned on, caption tracks picked on a tablet, and 1080p or 720p picked on a tablet. Includes the owner's testing in the TEST world, which these counts can't tell apart.

panels.title: Here lately
panels.description: Joins over the selected range by VRChat client language, from visitors who allow untrusted URLs. It counts arrivals, not who is still here. Dark: none; 1 grey; 2–3 blue; 4 or more purple.

panels.title: Search languages
panels.description: Searches with a query over the selected range, by VRChat client language; colours as in Here lately. Includes the owner's testing in the TEST world, which these counts can't tell apart.

panels.title: Quest and PC
panels.description: Over the selected range: plays by player platform (once per room and platform) and joins from visitors who allow untrusted URLs. Includes the owner's testing in the TEST world, which these counts can't tell apart.

panels.title: Through the night (Chicago time)
panels.description: People in the production world over the selected range, stacked by public and private instances, in Chicago time.

panels.title: Stayed past 03:00
panels.description: The most people in the world between 03:00 and 06:00 Chicago time within the selected range; "no one" also when the range holds no such hours. Do people sleep here?
